title: Elite: Foxfire Contracts: Hidden Law
description: Foxfire Contracts unfolds across foxfire torii road with cedar roots, shrine stones, and lantern smoke lanes, pushing a 5-Titan Kami squad to prove precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Foxfire Contracts: Hidden Law advances Kami Mirror Tempest: The Sacred Kingdoms test whether the Creator can cleanse Gate reflections without breaking shrine law or spirit contracts. It directly tests the faction tension: Their secrecy protects sacred balance but makes allies fear what they cannot see.
